days\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPedal edema since 7 days\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShortness of breath since 7 ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 12 days back then he complained of fever which is low grade, intermittent, on and off episodes get relieved on medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Patient complained of B\/L pedal edema present below the knees, pitting type, present since 7days which get aggravated on standing for long periods and slightly reduced on taking rest.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Shortness of breath present since 7 days which is grade 2(developing shortness of breath while walking to washroom).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-Patient also
